about.title: About Us
about.paragraph1: We are a leading company in the field of high-rise work in Israel, with over 15 years of experience in executing complex projects across the country. Our expertise is in rope access, building facade restoration, high-altitude sealing, stone cladding and anchoring, and bird control.
about.paragraph2: Our team consists of certified and experienced climbers with the highest level of professional training. We use the most advanced equipment and meet all required safety standards.
about.historyText: The company was founded in 2009 by our founder, a professional climber with extensive international high-rise work experience. The vision was to create a company that combines high professionalism, maximum safety, and personal service for every client. Today, we are proud to be one of the leading companies in the field in Israel.
